rulers.note: 9 June 1815 to 13 March 1824; 'Only accepted the investiture in 1817'; she did not take possession of the duchy until 1817.

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria has no row). The duchy 'was formed in 1815 by the Congress of Vienna, out of the former Republic of Lucca and the Principality of Lucca and Piombino' (Piombino went to Tuscany). The page gives no area; Lucca province in the gazetteer is about 1,517 km2.

region.text: the former Republic of Lucca: Lucca province

ledger.note: 9 June 1815: the Congress of Vienna creates the Duchy of Lucca. Infobox 'Congress of Vienna: 9 June 1815'; formed 'out of the former Republic of Lucca and the Principality of Lucca and Piombino'. Maria Luisa initially rejected the terms and took possession only in 1817.

region.text: the former Republic of Lucca: Lucca province

ledger.note: 17 December 1847: the Duchy of Lucca reverts to Tuscany. Infobox 'Reversion to the Grand Duchy of Tuscany: 17 December 1847'; Charles Louis abdicated on 5 October 1847 after agreeing by treaty with Leopold II 'to renounce the dukedom in advance'.

region.text: the former Republic of Lucca: Lucca province

ledger.note: 1847: the Duchy of Lucca ends. The Congress terms said the duchy 'would revert to Tuscany' when the Bourbon-Parma line ended or acquired another territory.

certainty.note: A Congress of Vienna creation inside the old republic's borders; the page gives no frontier text and no territorial exchange, and the Tuscan exchanges of 1847 (Lunigiana) are in the Tuscany dossier, not on this page.

sources.title: Duchy of Lucca
sources.note: Congress of Vienna 9 June 1815, rulers, abdication 5 October 1847, reversion to Tuscany 17 December 1847.

notes: New dossier, a state Cliopatria lacks (referenced as a counterpart by grand-duchy-of-tuscany). One page opened; it gives no area, no capital and no boundary. The page does not mention the 1844 Treaty of Florence or any Lunigiana, Pontremoli or Fivizzano transfers, which the Tuscany dossier ties to the 1847 reversion; the extent of the duchy is the old Lucca province as the gazetteer draws it. Charles Louis's reign dates (13 March 1824 to 5 October 1847) are the page's table. The ruler strip omits sources on the second entry only because one page gives both.
